systems.summary: Isolated game-owned Luau buffer jobs; native background threads, Web inline backend.
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.jobs reports SYSTEM_DISABLED; no worker pool starts.
systems.disable_when: Enable for independent coarse batches; Web v1 is synchronous, not a Web Worker or arbitrary WASM module executor.

systems.summary: ECS world state for entities, transforms, and sprites.
systems.when_disabled: Without the world there is no observable game state, so this system cannot be disabled.

systems.summary: Host input boundary for semantic actions and world/screen pointers.
systems.when_disabled: Deterministic tests cannot be replayed without input, so this system cannot be disabled.

systems.summary: Semantic projection and observation digest for the typed ViewModel.
systems.when_disabled: Semantic assertions cannot run without observations, so this system cannot be disabled.

systems.summary: Opt-in fixed-step Rapier 3D rigid bodies, sphere/box/capsule/convex/static triangle mesh, sensors, collision groups, CCD, sleeping, ray/shape queries and sorted contact lifecycle. Lua owns commands and gameplay reactions. Legacy moving-sphere sweep remains available.

Fixed-step integration for 2D rigid bodies: gravity, linear damping, ground bounce and friction, and circle collisions with per-frame contact points. There is no angular velocity, non-circular collider, sensor, or raycast.
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, the engine advances no rigid bodies and publishes no contacts; RigidBody2D keeps its scene initial values and api.physics reports SYSTEM_DISABLED.
systems.disable_when: Games without physics simulation, such as board, idle, AVG, and slot games; disabling this removes per-frame integration cost and unnecessary digest changes.

systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.camera reports SYSTEM_DISABLED; the snapshot still emits a default camera so the host has a fixed view.

systems.summary: 3D camera and observation projection for Mesh3D/Transform3D.
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.camera3d reports SYSTEM_DISABLED; api.entity 3D transforms are currently unaffected by this switch.
systems.disable_when: Pure 2D games; disabling this makes 'this project should not contain a 3D camera' a verifiable fact.
Fully deterministic games or level verification that permits no random source.

systems.summary: Deterministic UI tree transport for engine verification (screen/text/button/image/component with rects, asset ids and actions).
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.ui reports SYSTEM_DISABLED and the host receives no UI tree.
systems.disable_when: Headless simulations or games whose host builds the UI independently.

systems.summary: Transport for the game's versioned JSON save payload and migrations.
systems.disable_when: Level verification or demos without saved state.

systems.summary: Sound effects and BGM: the game publishes semantic audio events and loop state; the host decodes and mixes them.
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.audio reports SYSTEM_DISABLED and the snapshot contains no audio events or loops.
systems.disable_when: Silent games or verification projects that only compare visuals. Classification rules (exclusive/fade) are decided by the engine and included in the digest; hosts produce the actual sound, and the Web hosts currently play it while native preview and Android remain silent.

systems.summary: Spine skeletal animation: the game publishes semantic animation state; the host runs the Spine runtime.
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.animation reports SYSTEM_DISABLED; animation declared by the scene still appears in the snapshot.
systems.disable_when: Games without skeletal animation; this system is disabled by default. Currently only the web/presentation Web host plays it with spine-webgl; native preview and the Android host do not. The engine only owns transport and determinism.

systems.summary: Seeded fixed-frame 3D native particles, sampled by core and presented by the host.
systems.disable_when: Disable if the game has no native particle effects.

systems.summary: Effekseer effects: the game publishes semantic effect events; the host runs the Effekseer runtime.
systems.when_disabled: When disabled, api.effect reports SYSTEM_DISABLED and the snapshot contains no effects.
systems.disable_when: Games without particle effects; this system is disabled by default. Currently only the web/presentation Web host plays it with Effekseer for WebGL; native preview and the Android host do not. The engine only owns transport and determinism.
